Expression:
WITH predecessors 
AS (
	SELECT TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(PA.predecessorsidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS predecessor
		,PA.thematicididentifier

QC Description: If an identifier is the predecessor of 2 or more objects, then those objects must have wiseEvolution in ('splitting','changeBothAggregationAndSplitting')
Message: If an identifier is the predecessor of 2 or more objects, then those objects must have wiseEvolution in ('splitting','changeBothAggregationAndSplitting') [R029]
Expression:
WITH objectWithPredecessors
AS (
	
select	TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(PA.predecessorsidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS predecessor
		,PA.thematicididentifier
		,PA.wiseEvolutionType 
		,PA.predecessorsidentifierscheme
		,PA.record_id
	FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea" PA
	WHERE COALESCE(PA."predecessorsidentifier", '') <> ''
		
	)
	 
SELECT DISTINCT
    objectWithPredecessors.record_id,             
    objectWithPredecessors.thematicididentifier,   
    objectWithPredecessors.predecessor
FROM objectWithPredecessors

JOIN (
    SELECT
        predecessor,
        COUNT(DISTINCT thematicididentifier) AS cnt
    FROM objectWithPredecessors
    GROUP BY predecessor
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT thematicididentifier) >= 2
) AS preds
    ON objectWithPredecessors.predecessor = preds.predecessor
WHERE wiseEvolutionType NOT IN (
    'splitting',
    'changeBothAggregationAndSplitting'
)

QC Description: If an object is reported as 'deletion', it must have the same predecessors as before
Message: If an object is reported as 'deletion', it must have the same predecessors as before [RF005]
Expression:
WITH unnested_predecessors AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(FLATTEN(
            REGEXP_SPLIT(M.predecessorsidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999)
        )) AS predecessorsidentifier,
        M.thematicididentifier,
        M.record_id
    FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea" M
    WHERE COALESCE(M.predecessorsidentifier, '') <> ''
      AND M.wiseevolutiontype = 'deletion'
),

unnested_reference AS (
    SELECT 
        R.thematicididentifier,
        TRIM(FLATTEN(
            REGEXP_SPLIT(R.predecessorsidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999)
        )) AS predecessorsidentifier
    FROM dataset_46376."protectedarea" R
    WHERE COALESCE(R.predecessorsidentifier, '') <> ''
),

preordered_report AS (
    SELECT 
        thematicididentifier,
        predecessorsidentifier,
        record_id
    FROM unnested_predecessors
    ORDER BY thematicididentifier, predecessorsidentifier
),

ordered_report AS (
    SELECT 
        thematicididentifier,
        ARRAY_AGG(predecessorsidentifier) AS sorted_predecessors,
        MAX(record_id) AS record_id
    FROM preordered_report
    GROUP BY thematicididentifier
),

preordered_reference AS (
    SELECT 
        thematicididentifier,
        predecessorsidentifier
    FROM unnested_reference
    ORDER BY thematicididentifier, predecessorsidentifier
),

ordered_reference AS (
    SELECT 
        thematicididentifier,
        ARRAY_AGG(predecessorsidentifier) AS sorted_predecessors
    FROM preordered_reference
    GROUP BY thematicididentifier
)

SELECT 
    r.thematicididentifier,
    r.sorted_predecessors AS reported_predecessors,
    ref_data.sorted_predecessors AS reference_predecessors,
    r.record_id
FROM ordered_report r
LEFT JOIN ordered_reference ref_data 
       ON r.thematicididentifier = ref_data.thematicididentifier
WHERE 
    CARDINALITY(r.sorted_predecessors) > 0
    AND (
           ref_data.thematicididentifier IS NULL
        OR r.sorted_predecessors <> ref_data.sorted_predecessors
    )

QC Description: The geometry of the protected areas must be covered by or be within 200 metre of the geometry of the associated water body.
Message: The geometry of the protected areas must be covered by or be within 200 metre of the geometry of the associated water body.[S014]
Expression:
WITH vProtectedArea AS
 
    (SELECT record_id,
            "thematicididentifier",
            "relatedzoneidentifier",
            "relatedzoneidentifierscheme",
            CASE
               WHEN geometry_polygon <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY) THEN geometry_polygon
               WHEN geometry_point  <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY)  THEN geometry_point
               WHEN geometry_line  <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY)  THEN geometry_line
               ELSE NULL
            END AS geometry_any
    FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea" )
    
,vDimensionOriginal AS
(select  record_id,
            "thematicididentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifierscheme",
            geometry_any,
           -- ST_GeometryType(geometry_any) AS geometry_type, 
        case 
            when ST_Area(geometry_any) > 0 then 2 
            when ST_Length(geometry_any) > 0 and ST_Area(geometry_any) = 0 then 1 
            when ST_Length(geometry_any) = 0 then 0 
            else -1 -- Unknown 
        end as geometry_dim
from    vProtectedArea  
where   coalesce(geometry_any,'') <> '' )

,vReportedZone_MakeValidGeometry AS  -- so that GEOS doesn't go berserk
 
    (SELECT record_id,
            "thematicididentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifierscheme",  
            ST_MakeValid(geometry_any) AS geometry_any, 
            --geometry_type,
            geometry_dim
     FROM vDimensionOriginal 
     WHERE geometry_any <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY))
 
,vDimensionMakeValid AS
(select  record_id,
            "thematicididentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifierscheme",
            geometry_any,
            --geometry_type, 
            geometry_dim,
        case 
            when ST_Area(geometry_any) > 0 then 2 
            when ST_Length(geometry_any) > 0 and ST_Area(geometry_any) = 0 then 1 
            when ST_Length(geometry_any) = 0 then 0 
            else -1 -- Unknown 
        end as geometry_dimMakeValid
from    vReportedZone_MakeValidGeometry 
where   geometry_any <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY) )


,vReportedZone_IsValidGeometry AS  -- only correct things move to the next phase
 
    (SELECT record_id,
           "thematicididentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifier", 
            "relatedzoneidentifierscheme",     
            geometry_any
            
     FROM vDimensionMakeValid 
     WHERE ST_IsValid(geometry_any)                    -- if the geometry is valid
     AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geometry_any)                  -- if the geometry is not empty
     AND geometry_dimMakeValid = geometry_dim     -- if it didn't collapse to a lower dimension
     --AND ST_GeometryType(geometry_any) = geometry_type 
     ) -- if it didn't become a geometry collection or something weird


SELECT
    PA."thematicididentifier",
    PA.record_id,
    PA."relatedzoneidentifier",
    RELATEDWB.thematicididentifier
    --RELATEDWB.geometry_buffer200
FROM
    vReportedZone_IsValidGeometry PA
JOIN dataset_46376."relatedzone" RELATEDWB ON PA."relatedzoneidentifier" = RELATEDWB."thematicididentifier" AND PA."relatedzoneidentifierscheme" = RELATEDWB."thematicididentifierscheme"

WHERE coalesce(PA."relatedzoneidentifier",'') <> ''
AND 
( RELATEDWB.geometry_buffer200 <> CAST('' AS VARBINARY) AND 
    NOT ST_Within(
        ST_Transform(PA.geometry_any, 3035),
        RELATEDWB.geometry_buffer200  -- ya en 3035
    )
)

QC Description: Objects with the same predecessor must have the same designationPeriodBegin value.[R035]
Message: Objects with the same predecessor must have the same designationPeriodBegin value: {%RECORDS%}. [R035]
Expression:
WITH OnePredecessor AS (
    select  record_id,
            thematicIdIdentifier,
            thematicIdIdentifierScheme,
            TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(predecessorsIdentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS onePredecessorIdentifier,
            designationPeriodBegin
               
    from    dataset_46374."protectedarea" 
    where   -- Avoids values not reported
            coalesce(predecessorsIdentifier, '') <> ''
),
PredecessorsDifferentDate AS (
    select  distinct P1.onePredecessorIdentifier
    from    OnePredecessor P1
            join OnePredecessor P2 on
                P1.onePredecessorIdentifier = P2.onePredecessorIdentifier
                and (P1.thematicIdIdentifier <> P2.thematicIdIdentifier)
                and coalesce(P1.designationPeriodBegin,'') <> coalesce(P2.designationPeriodBegin,'')
)
select  OP.record_id,
        OP.thematicIdIdentifier,
        OP.thematicIdIdentifierScheme,
        LISTAGG(CONCAT('[', OP.onePredecessorIdentifier, ' / ', OP.designationPeriodBegin, ']'), ', ') AS RECORDS
from    OnePredecessor OP
        join PredecessorsDifferentDate PDD on
            PDD.onePredecessorIdentifier = OP.onePredecessorIdentifier
group by OP.record_id, OP.thematicIdIdentifier, OP.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
having count(*) > 0

QC Description: A valid 'eu' thematic identifier exists in the register but was not reported in the spatial file (either as a spatial object or as a predecessor).
Message: A valid 'eu' thematic identifier exists in the register but was not reported in the spatial file (either as a spatial object or as a predecessor).[RF001] Number of missing identifiers: {%NUMBEROFRECORDS%}. Missing identifiers: {%IDENTIFIERS%}
Expression:
WITH predecessors
AS (
	SELECT TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(PA.predecessorsIdentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS predecessor
		,PA.thematicIdIdentifier
		,PA.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
		,PA.predecessorsIdentifierScheme
		,PA.record_id
	FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea" PA
	WHERE COALESCE(PA.predecessorsIdentifier, '') <> ''
	)
SELECT
    X.record_id,
    CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(X.ids) > 3997 THEN
            CONCAT(
                LEFT(
                    X.ids,
                    3997 - POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997 )))
                ),
                '...'
            )
        ELSE X.ids
    END AS IDENTIFIERS,
    X.NUMBEROFRECORDS
FROM (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MIN(record_id) FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea") AS record_id,
        
        listagg(RF.thematicIdIdentifier, ', ') as ids,
        COUNT(*) AS numberofrecords
    FROM dataset_46376."protectedarea" RF
    LEFT JOIN dataset_46374."protectedarea" D
        ON D.thematicIdIdentifier = RF.thematicIdIdentifier
       AND D.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = RF.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
    LEFT JOIN predecessors P
        ON P.predecessor = RF.thematicIdIdentifier
       AND P.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = RF.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
    WHERE RF.countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
    AND (D.thematicIdIdentifier IS NULL AND P.predecessor IS NULL)
    AND RF.zonetype = 'designatedWaters'
    AND RF.wiseEvolutionType <> 'deletion'
    AND RF.statuscode NOT IN ('deprecated','retired','superseded')
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) X

QC Description: If wiseEvolutionType = 'deletion then the designationPeriodEnd value must not be after @today

FROM dataset_46374."protectedarea"
WHERE wiseevolutiontype = 'deletion'
AND
    CASE
        -- YYYY → YYYY-01-01
        WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(designationperiodend, '^[0-9]{4}$') THEN
            TO_DATE(designationperiodend || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

        -- YYYY-MM → YYYY-MM-01
        WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(designationperiodend, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$') THEN
            TO_DATE(designationperiodend || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

        -- YYYY-MM-DD → ya es fecha válida
        WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(designationperiodend, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$') THEN
            TO_DATE(designationperiodend, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

        ELSE NULL
    END
> CURRENT_DATE

FROM vPAValid2 PA
JOIN vSurfaceWaterBody WB
    ON PA."relatedzoneidentifier" = WB.wb_id
   AND PA."relatedzoneidentifierscheme" = WB.wb_scheme
JOIN vRBDValid2 RBD
    ON WB.rbd_id = RBD.rbd_id
   AND WB.rbd_scheme = RBD.rbd_scheme
WHERE coalesce(PA."relatedzoneidentifier",'') <> ''
  AND coalesce(WB.wb_category,'') NOT IN ('coastalWaters','territorialWaters')
  AND (
      ST_Disjoint (PA.geometry_any, RBD.geometry_polygon)=true
      )
